text:
maya: Heads-up
we have two external visitors showing up for 11:30 drop-in (no RSVP). Can reception badge them quickly?
frontdesk-bot: @maya noted. Please PM names so we can pre-print. Kiosk B is warmed up. :printer:
maya: Names: Nina Wells and Tom Ito. They're here for a casual product tour.
people-ops: We'll pre-print temporary badges. Remind them to show ID. If anyone needs a parking pass, we have 2 visitor passes left for Lot C.
carlos: Can you save one pass? I'm bringing a contractor who may arrive at 11:20.
people-ops: Reserved one pass for @carlos. Please collect at reception.
sasha: Quick thing  front desk says a small box addressed to "Nina W." was delivered earlier to Locker 2B but the label matches a different company. It might be misdelivered. :thinking_face:
frontdesk-bot: Package details: courier 'FastShip', tracking 1Z999AA101, left at 09:14, Locker 2B. Marked "fragile".
maya: That's probably the demo dongles. If it's not ours please keep it sealed. Nina's company is "Wellside" which could match.
facilities: I'll swing by reception to check and will not open it. If label mismatch, we'll hold for 48 hours then return to sender.
carlos: Also FYI, the small meeting bench near the pantry is taken today. If the visitors need seating before the tour, there's a spare high-top in 2E.
sasha: If anyone needs to plug in AV, there's a 3m HDMI cable in the drawer marked `AV-KITS`.
frontdesk-bot: Reception update: Badges printed and in "Pre-printed" tray. Lot C pass taped to badge as requested. Locker 2B contents confirmed addressed to Nina Wells / Wellside; still sealed.
maya: Thanks all  I'll meet them in the lobby at 11:25 and escort to the tour. If the package ends up being ours, can someone drop it off in 2F?
people-ops: Noted. We'll log this on today's visitor ledger for badge reconciliation and package holding. Reminder to hosts: return temporary badges to dropbox by exit. :white_check_mark:
